title: I created a tower defence game that you can play with any postcode, anywhere in the world. Every time it's different and most of all it's FUN
author: Apprehensive-Eye1176
selftext:
[https://goalmine.games/doorstep](https://goalmine.games/doorstep)  
  
I love tower defence games and now I've been given the opportunity to build my own. Simple premise, enter a postcode and play on the streets. Play in central London, Manhattan or even your own street. With whimsical rube goldberg inspired towers and enemies that go through the ages, hopefully you will have as much fun playing as I have.

I've been working with claude code for about 18 months now for work and decided to take this on with the release of Opus 5.5. Have been loving building it and adding new features all the time. Please have a play and submit feedback as I will incorporate. 

Also, if you decide to purchase the premium version, half of all profits will be donated to Shelter Charity, a charity in the UK fighting homelessness. Thank you
